zones_not_installed.title: Protect Detections needs Protect Zones
zones_not_installed.description:
Protect Detections uses the connection to UniFi Protect that the Protect Zones integration provides, and Protect Zones isn't installed.

Install Protect Zones (through HACS, or by copying it into `custom_components`), restart Home Assistant, then reload Protect Detections.
